summary: It's the season of silly yet again, let the cats and dogs roam free! Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.tldr: Base armor increased to 47 from 44.; Base health increased 685 from 670.
champions.gameplayImpact: Alistar is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
